dataset: MM-Fi: balanced cohort of 20 subjects and 27 actions
consent_basis: The MM-Fi authors report signed participant consent and NTU approval IRB-2022-1067; this use is noncommercial research.
scope_note: The 40-subject expansion is blocked by a verified Google Drive quota response. This cohort includes only the 20 subjects with complete recordings for all 27 actions.
coordinate_note: A declared 640 by 640 annotation reference plane preserves isotropic pixel geometry. It is not recovered camera calibration.
